dsd.title: shopify-lit islands
dsd.intro: Liquid paints first from compiled Lit templates. vulpine-loader defers the module. ShopifyLitElement absorbs the DOM and binds handlers.
dsd.interaction_hint: Click + / −. The module loads, then that same click is replayed.
dsd.visible_hint: Scroll down. The qty stepper loads when it enters the viewport.
dsd.idle_hint: Loads when the browser is idle (requestIdleCallback), then + / − work.
dsd.product_card_hint: Real catalog products. Each card is compiled Liquid; Add to cart binds after the island loads.
dsd.product_card_empty: No products in this collection yet. Add products in Admin, or pick a collection in the section settings.
dsd.scroll_spacer: Keep scrolling for the visible island ↓
dsd.no_js_note: With JavaScript disabled you still see styled markup (images included); controls just aren’t interactive.
